summary: Iter 215bc testing - Mobile washout fix VERIFIED, mobile button fix VERIFIED, backend trial duration (3-day) VERIFIED. CRITICAL ISSUES FOUND: (1) Trial modal submit button still says '14-day' instead of '3-day', (2) Pricing page has 3 places still showing '14 days', (3) Member-facing routes (/members, /m/:slug) show data-brand='gymaxis' instead of 'pulse' due to missing check in App.js initial useEffect, (4) Pulse landing page shows '14-day free trial'.

ui_bugs.issue: Submit button text says 'Start 14-day Trial' instead of 'Start 3-day Trial'
Hero subtitle says 'Start free for 14 days' instead of '3 days'
FAQ answer says '14 days free' instead of '3 days'
CTA section says '14 days free' instead of '3 days'
ui_bugs.fix: Change '14 days free' to '3 days free'

integration_issues.issue: /members and /m/:slug routes show data-brand='gymaxis' instead of 'pulse' when logged out
integration_issues.root_cause: App.js initial useEffect (lines 141-147) doesn't include isMemberFacingRoute check - only BrandAttrSync has it but runs after initial useEffect
integration_issues.fix: Add isMemberFacingRoute check to the initial useEffect in App.js (lines 141-147)

action_items: FIX: TrialSignupModal.js line 186 - Change 'Start 14-day Trial' to 'Start 3-day Trial'
FIX: PricingMarketingPage.js line 116 - Change 'Start free for 14 days' to 'Start free for 3 days'
FIX: PricingMarketingPage.js line 84 - Change '14 days free' to '3 days free' in FAQ
FIX: PricingMarketingPage.js line 282 - Change '14 days free' to '3 days free' in CTA
FIX: App.js lines 141-147 - Add isMemberFacingRoute check to initial useEffect for /members and /m/:slug routes
FIX: PulseLandingPage.js - Update '14-day free trial' to '3-day free trial'
critical_code_review_comments: TrialSignupModal.js: Eyebrow and subtitle correctly show 3-day, but submit button text on line 186 still says '14-day'
PricingMarketingPage.js: Multiple hardcoded '14 days' strings need updating to '3 days'
App.js: BrandAttrSync (lines 466-484) correctly handles member-facing routes, but initial useEffect (lines 141-147) doesn't - causes race condition where initial value is wrong
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 215bc mobile washout and button fixes VERIFIED working. Backend trial duration (3-day) VERIFIED.
